teaser: Forking as the way people adopt our cells: fork a template, point Claude at it, and it is yours. Five ways, fork-ready repositories, and a hub.
core_idea: Make every cell and template site easy to fork and make your own, list many on a hub, and let forks and requests decide what we build and sell.

figures.caption: Five ways to make a cell yours: fork on GitHub, one-click deploy, run it in your assistant, a vault, ask us.
What makes a repository fork-ready: built for a stranger with Claude, not only for our own factory.
The fork loop: make many templates, list them on the hub, watch what is forked, invest where it pulls, keep forks alive.
